def make_simpson(seed=73, n=400):
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    sex = rng.integers(0, 2, n)                             # 0 = 암컷, 1 = 수컷
    dose = np.clip(rng.normal(2 + 4*sex, 1.5), 0, 10)       # 수컷이 더 많이 먹는다
    vigor = 55 + 20*sex - 1.5*dose + rng.normal(0, 4, n)    # 심은 값: 성별 +20, 복용량 -1.5
    return pd.DataFrame({"sex": sex, "dose": dose.round(1), "vigor": vigor.round(1)})

zg = make_simpson()
print(round(np.polyfit(zg.dose, zg.vigor, 1)[0], 2))

def 세_세계(seed=73, n=2000):
    g = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    C = g.normal(0,1,n); X1 = .8*C + g.normal(0,1,n); Y1 = .8*C + g.normal(0,1,n)
    X2 = g.normal(0,1,n); M2 = .8*X2 + g.normal(0,1,n); Y2 = .8*M2 + g.normal(0,1,n)
    X3 = g.normal(0,1,n); Y3 = g.normal(0,1,n); C3 = .8*X3 + .8*Y3 + g.normal(0,1,n)
    return {"혼란": (X1,Y1,C), "사슬": (X2,Y2,M2), "충돌": (X3,Y3,C3)}

def 차이(X, Y, keep=None):                       # X 상위 절반과 하위 절반의 Y 평균차
    m = np.median(X[keep]) if keep is not None else np.median(X)
    sel = np.ones(len(X), bool) if keep is None else keep
    return Y[sel & (X > m)].mean() - Y[sel & (X <= m)].mean()

for name, (X, Y, Z) in 세_세계().items():
    q = pd.qcut(Z, 10, labels=False)             # 제3변수를 열 층으로
    층별 = [차이(X, Y, q == k) for k in range(10)]
    print(name, round(차이(X, Y), 2), round(float(np.mean(층별)), 2))
# 혼란 0.89 0.1
# 사슬 1.02 0.03
# 충돌 -0.11 -0.58

g = np.random.default_rng(73)
ng, per = 30, 40
grp = np.repeat(np.arange(ng), per)
lvl = g.normal(0, 1, ng)[grp]                      # 집단마다 다른 수준
e = g.normal(0, 1, ng * per)
x = lvl + e
y = lvl - 0.62 * e + g.normal(0, .6, ng * per)     # 집단 안에서는 반대로 움직인다
d = pd.DataFrame({"g": grp, "x": x, "y": y})
gm = d.groupby("g").mean()
wi = d.groupby("g")[["x", "y"]].transform(lambda v: v - v.mean())
print(round(d.x.corr(d.y), 3), round(wi.x.corr(wi.y), 3), round(gm.x.corr(gm.y), 3))
# 0.237 -0.729 0.973

def make2(seed=73, n=400, sexeff=20.0):        # 성별 → 기력 만 조절
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    sex = rng.integers(0, 2, n)
    dose = np.clip(rng.normal(2 + 4*sex, 1.5), 0, 10)
    vigor = 55 + sexeff*sex - 1.5*dose + rng.normal(0, 4, n)
    return pd.DataFrame({"sex": sex, "dose": dose.round(1), "vigor": vigor.round(1)})

for e in (20.0, 0.0):
    print(e, round(np.polyfit(make2(sexeff=e).dose, make2(sexeff=e).vigor, 1)[0], 2))
# 20.0 1.7
# 0.0 -1.66
